categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance NdFeB permanent magnetic materials, magnetic components, and rare earth permanent magnet material recycling. Its products serve key sectors including new energy vehicles and automotive parts, energy-saving variable frequency air conditioners, wind power generation, robotics and industrial servo motors, 3C electronics, low-altitude aircraft, energy-saving elevators, and rail transit. The company also actively develops magnetic components for humanoid robots and low-altitude aircraft.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary core technologies including grain boundary diffusion, formula systems, grain refinement, one-time forming, automated production processes, and new high-temperature and corrosion-resistant coatings. Over 90% of its high-performance rare earth permanent magnet products use grain boundary diffusion technology. It also focuses on intelligent manufacturing, aiming to build automated, intelligent, and digital production systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include the top global manufacturers in new energy vehicles, variable frequency air conditioner compressors, and wind turbine original equipment manufacturers. The company’s products are used by the top 10 global new energy vehicle producers, eight of the top 10 global variable frequency air conditioner compressor manufacturers, and five of the top 10 global wind turbine manufacturers. It also serves emerging markets such as humanoid robots, 3C electronics, low-altitude aircraft, and rail transit.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jiangxi, Inner Mongolia (Baotou), and Zhejiang (Ningbo). It has established wholly-owned subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, Europe (Netherlands), Japan, the United States, Mexico, and South Korea, supporting global sales and service.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the production of high-performance NdFeB magnetic materials and magnetic components. It also engages in upstream rare earth material procurement through strategic partnerships with major rare earth suppliers and downstream integration via magnetic component manufacturing and recycling.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity to 60,000 tons of high-performance rare earth permanent magnets by 2027, developing advanced humanoid robot magnetic components, and enhancing R&D in reducing heavy rare earth usage, improving automation, and upgrading production facilities. The company invests heavily in innovation projects such as high-reliability magnetic steel, green manufacturing, high-temperature resistant magnets, and automation equipment development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance NdFeB magnetic materials and magnetic components. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on confirmed orders, with sales concentrated in domestic and international markets. It also earns income from recycling rare earth permanent magnet materials and receives government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leader and the largest producer by volume in the rare earth permanent magnet industry. It holds leading market shares in key downstream sectors and maintains strong competitive advantages through proprietary technology, scale, and strategic supplier relationships. Competitors include other major rare earth and permanent magnet producers, but the company’s scale and technology leadership distinguish it.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.76 billion, a 1.13% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 291 million, a decline due to raw material price fluctuations and increased costs. Production and sales volumes reached record highs with over 29,300 tons produced and 20,850 tons sold. The company maintains strong cash reserves and a stable financial structure, with ongoing investments to expand capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership in high-performance NdFeB magnets, especially its proprietary grain boundary diffusion technology, which enhances magnet performance and reduces heavy rare earth usage. It offers customized solutions to meet stringent quality and delivery requirements of leading global customers. Its multi-base production strategy ensures supply chain security and cost advantages, while its commitment to ESG and sustainable development supports carbon neutrality goals.
